title: General Material Blend 4-Mix Solo #18 (세로 띠·물결 | 드래곤비늘+인어비늘+금박+석재)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Japanese woman, an adult, in her late 30s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone — an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, pale, almost translucent skin, heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips, a hollow, half-lidded expression, warm honey-blonde hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real pores, real living eyes, 50 bars piercings set with opals in silver-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of rose-gold a necklace. Full body fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 vertical bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 42% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 61% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 78% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID DEEP EMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL scale formations, VIVID SILVER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries applied ELECTRIC CRIMSON leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 4 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries solid polished white marble fused directly into her own form, natural grey-gold veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING pale marble surface with VIVID golden vein striations. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
